cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

mechanism: Copy a host's key placement without understanding its dry cup, then bring tea, invitation and key back as successive forms of one access failure.
confusable: Not merely listing old props: each returning detail must causally change the same impending inability to enter the wedding hall, with copied certainty maintained.
comparison: A sticky key and unreadable venue address differ from chairs, cake and a blocked window.
seedUse: Retains key/cup/invitation chain; adds copied placement into a different cup and a concrete access task.
